package fixture

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	base "example.com/narrowfixture/fixture/base"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"unsafe"
)

type oracleCase struct {
	Name          string
	Bits, Result  int
	Addr          int32
	Initial       string
	Args          []string
	Before, After string
	Trap          bool
	Old           string
}

var operations = map[string]func(*base.Module, int32, []uint64) uint64{
	/*REGISTRY*/
}

func fixtureMemory(t *testing.T) (*base.Module, func()) {
	t.Helper()
	var b []byte
	close := func() {}
	if os.Getenv("FIXTURE_BACKING") == "mmap" {
		owner, e := base.NewMemoryMapping(65536, 131072)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		b = owner.Bytes()
		close = func() {
			if e := owner.Close(); e != nil {
				t.Error(e)
			}
		}
	} else {
		b = make([]byte, 131072)
	}
	size := new(atomic.Uint64)
	size.Store(65536)
	m := &base.Module{Memory: b, M: unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]), MemSize: size, MemMu: new(sync.Mutex), MemShared: true, Threads: &base.ThreadPool{}}
	base.ForceContendedAtomics(m)
	return m, close
}
func sum(b []byte) string { s := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(s[:]) }
func TestConvertedNarrowWasmOracle(t *testing.T) {
	data, e := os.ReadFile("reference-results.json")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var cases []oracleCase
	if e = json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		func() {
			m, close := fixtureMemory(t)
			defer close()
			for i := 60; i < 80; i++ {
				m.Memory[i] = 0x57
			}
			v, e := strconv.ParseUint(c.Initial, 16, 64)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			width := c.Bits / 8
			if c.Addr >= 0 && uint64(uint32(c.Addr))+uint64(width) <= 65536 {
				for i := 0; i < width; i++ {
					m.Memory[int(c.Addr)+i] = byte(v >> uint(8*i))
				}
			}
			if sum(m.Memory[:65536]) != c.Before {
				t.Fatal("oracle initial identity", c.Name)
			}
			args := []uint64{}
			for _, a := range c.Args {
				x, e := strconv.ParseUint(a, 16, 64)
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				args = append(args, x)
			}
			var got uint64
			trapped := false
			func() {
				defer func() {
					if p := recover(); p != nil {
						s := fmt.Sprint(p)
						if !strings.Contains(s, "wasm:") || (!strings.Contains(s, "out of bounds") && !strings.Contains(s, "unaligned")) {
							panic(p)
						}
						trapped = true
					}
				}()
				got = operations[c.Name](m, c.Addr, args)
			}()
			want, e := strconv.ParseUint(c.Old, 16, 64)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if trapped != c.Trap || got != want || sum(m.Memory[:65536]) != c.After {
				t.Fatalf("Wasm mismatch %+v got old=%x trap=%v", c, got, trapped)
			}
		}()
	}
	fmt.Println("PASS", len(cases), "real Wasm reference cases")
}
func TestConvertedNarrowConcurrent(t *testing.T) {
	m, close := fixtureMemory(t)
	defer close()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(4)
	for worker := 0; worker < 4; worker++ {
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for i := 0; i < 10000; i++ {
				Add64_16(m, 66, 1)
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if Load64_16(m, 66) != 40000 {
		t.Fatal("lost i64 narrow increment")
	}
}
